signature.composition: buffer lower left, U8 card upper right

prompt: Create exactly one SQUARE 1:1 flat icon on white, showing retrieval of an unsigned 8-bit value from a tag buffer. Place a small dark-blue rectangular buffer in the LOWER LEFT and a large orange value card in the UPPER RIGHT. A single thick blue arrow rises diagonally from the buffer toward the card; it must not be vertical or horizontal. The card shows only very large black upright U8, with generous space between U and 8 and two big white holes inside the 8. No tray, no other text, no border or shadows; generous white margins.
